response.justification: While Bogdan has extensive full-stack and systems experience, there is minimal evidence of deep JVM, Java/Kotlin, or enterprise IDE tooling expertise — key requirements for this role. His work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile apps, with only superficial Java exposure in past roles without context of Spring, build tools, or IDE internals.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background across diverse platforms
Proven track record in open-source tooling and developer-focused projects
Excellent communication skills demonstrated through workshops and talks
concerns: Lack of demonstrated experience with Spring, Quarkus, or JVM-based enterprise frameworks
No evidence of IDE internals, language server protocol, or code analysis tooling work
Java usage appears incidental, not deep or recent, with no Kotlin exposure
